sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Retain the prior ballast-tank implication, boolean datatype, ship ownership, and directional forward-draught formula repairs. The ballast-tank sh:or still permits missing branch-selection evidence: require both situatedAboveLowerIceWaterline and usedToReachLowerIceWaterline, and enforce freezingPreventionPresent=true exactly when both are true; allow either explicitly present false case without requiring freezing prevention. The UIWL selection remains absent: the candidate merely requires an upper ice waterline and checks a ship-level displacementAtUpperIceWaterline, without proving that it corresponds to the greatest displacement among all linked UIWLs. Do not move or duplicate displacement facts.
